_note: Deterministic rule-based assistant copy. Shared by backend (Python) and offline Flutter engine (Dart). Placeholders in {braces} are filled only with facts computed from catalog/policy data.

en.delivery_no_guarantee: I can show the store's estimated delivery window, but I can't guarantee {target}.
en.delivery_window: For {city}, the store's estimated delivery window is {start} to {end} ({min}-{max} business days if you order today).
en.delivery_default_city: I don't have a city-specific estimate for {city}, so this is the store's general estimate.
en.delivery_before: That whole window ends on or before {target}.
en.delivery_possible: {target} is inside the window, so it's possible but not certain.
en.delivery_after: {target} is earlier than the window, so it's unlikely.
en.cod_yes: Yes, cash on delivery is available for this order in {city} (store limit PKR {max}). You can confirm COD on the checkout link.
en.cod_no_product: Cash on delivery isn't available for {items} under the store's policy. You can choose online payment at checkout.
en.cod_no_city: Under the store's current policy, cash on delivery isn't offered in {city}. Online payment is available.
en.cod_over_limit: The store allows COD up to PKR {max}. This order is PKR {total}, so it needs online payment.
en.shipping_fee: Shipping to {city} is PKR {fee}, and it's free on orders over PKR {threshold}. Your cart is PKR {subtotal}, so shipping is {current}.
en.size_requested_out: {size} is out of stock right now.
en.stock_out_size: {product} in {size} is out of stock right now. In stock: {sizes}.
en.stock_out_all: {product} is out of stock right now, and I can't promise a restock date. A similar in-stock option is {alt} (PKR {alt_price}). Or reply "human" and the team will help.
en.stock_out_no_alt: {product} is out of stock right now, and I can't promise a restock date. Reply "human" and the team will help.
en.discount_issued: I can offer {pct}% off, the most the store allows for this order. Your single-use code {code} is applied on your checkout link.
en.discount_capped: I can't offer {req}%. The store's limit is {pct}%.
en.discount_existing: Your code {code} ({pct}% off) is already applied on your checkout link.
en.discount_none: Sorry, the store isn't offering a discount on this order.
en.checkout_link: Here's your secure checkout link. Your cart is saved.
en.human: I'm connecting you with the {store} team. A person will reply here.
en.unknown: I'm not sure about that, so I've asked the {store} team to help. They'll reply here.
en.injection: I can only help with this order: size, delivery, COD, returns and checkout.
en.opt_out: You're unsubscribed. {store} won't send you more WhatsApp messages about this cart.
en.greeting: Hi {first_name}! Ask me about size, delivery, COD or returns, or say "link" for your checkout link.
en.thanks: You're welcome! Your checkout link stays active.
en.no_cart: I couldn't find an active cart for this chat.
